daily_summary: 当日提交覆盖模型、多模态、内核、量化、API 与构建等多个方向：LLaVA-NeXT 新增 vision tower 与 connector 的 LoRA 支持；视频解码后端从单一 video.py 大规模重构为按后端懒加载的 video_decoders 包；DeepSeek V3.2 Triton 融合内核加固 CUDA grid-y 边界；DeepSeek V3.2 新增复制式 embedding+norm 融合路径（VLLM_REPLICATE_EMBED）；Cohere 模型修正 sliding_window 语义、支持 RMSNorm 并融合 attention+MLP all-reduce；ROCm WNA16 MoE int4/int8 量化修复；Gemma4 parser enable_thinking 默认值与模板对齐；Completion API 接受 logprobs=-1；/detokenize 客户端错误改回 4xx；DeepSeek V4 mHC 广播 buffer 地址稳定性修复；MXFP8 FlashInfer 路径增加可用性守卫。构建侧升级 FlashInfer 0.6.17、更新 XPU manager 至 v2.1.0，并将 vLLM Python 版本传播到 Rust 二进制（--version 与 /version 接口）。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日 vLLM 变更对 vllm-ascend 无直接影响。所有提交均未命中"必然影响"路径（Platform/WorkerBase/GPUModelRunner/AttentionBackend/KVCacheSpec/DeviceCommunicatorBase/Scheduler 等核心抽象接口均无改动）；命中"可能影响"的共享模块变更（vllm/multimodal 视频解码重构、vllm/model_executor/models 的 LlavaNext/Cohere 模型修改、model_executor/layers/quantization 的 WNA16 修复）均为保持公共接口的增量式改动或后端特定修复，vllm-ascend 无需同步修改。DeepSeek V3.2/V4 相关改动位于 nvidia 特定目录或针对 CUDA 硬件边界，vllm-ascend 使用自有算子与模型实现，不受影响。

commits.comment: 为 hybrid KV cache 在 DCP（decode context parallelism）下启用 partial（细粒度）prefix cache hit。HybridKVCacheCoordinator 的 enable_partial_hash_hits 不再要求 dcp_world_size==1，而是允许 DCP 下 Mamba 'align' spec 的 block_size >= hash_block_size（因为 DCP 会把有效 full-attention block 放大 dcp_world_size 倍）。GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache 改为按 cache 类型调用 spec.max_num_blocks_per_req() 计算每个 KV group 的最大块数，区分 DCP 分片的 attention KV 与跨 DCP 复制的 Mamba/GDN 状态；BlockTables.append_block_ids 新增行容量越界检查，避免写坏下一行。测试大幅扩展：partial hit + DCP + CoW、Eagle 回退一个 hash 单元、复制 Mamba snapshot 边界、以及块表宽度不 shard Mamba 等。注意：新越界检查会把之前的静默越界变成显式 RuntimeError，块宽计算方式变化也会影响 hybrid 模型 block table 尺寸。

ascend_impact.functionality: 影响 vLLM v1 共享核心路径：1) vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_coordinator.py 的 HybridKVCacheCoordinator 放宽 enable_partial_hash_hits 条件——DCP 下只要 Mamba 'align' spec 的 block_size >= hash_block_size 即启用细粒度 partial prefix cache hit。vllm-ascend 的 hybrid（attention+Mamba/GDN）模型在 NPU 上使用 DCP 时，缓存命中、CoW 和块分配语义随之改变。2) vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py 的 GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache 改为调用 spec.max_num_blocks_per_req(vllm_config, max_model_len) 计算每类 KV group 的最大块数，区分 DCP 分片的 attention KV（按 block_size*dcp_size 缩放）与跨 DCP 复制的 Mamba/GDN 状态（按全局长度计）。vllm-ascend 的 NPUModelRunnerV2 继承 GPUModelRunner，其自定义 KV cache spec（如 AscendMLAAttentionSpec、MambaSpec 变体）需正确实现/覆写该方法，否则块表宽度会改变。3) BlockTables.append_block_ids 新增行容量越界 RuntimeError 检查，Ascend 侧若复用 vLLM 的 BlockTables 且此前依赖静默覆盖，将暴露为显式错误。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 应在 NPU 上验证 hybrid 模型 + DCP + prefix caching 的块表宽度、partial hash hit 与 CoW 行为，并确认自定义 KV cache spec 的 max_num_blocks_per_req 语义与 Mamba 'align' 快照边界。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend KV cache coordinator / partial prefix cache（DCP）测试
hybrid Mamba/GDN + attention 块表宽度（NPU）

[ModelRunnerV2] Support prompt embeds (#42963)

Signed-off-by: gcanlin <canlinguosdu@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Canlin Guo <961750412@qq.com>
Signed-off-by: Nick Hill <nickhill123@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Nick Hill <nickhill123@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: NPUModelRunner (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py) — inherits GPUModelRunner; new uses_inputs_embeds gate, prepare_inputs_embeds (renamed from get_mm_embeddings), add_requests via NewRequestData.prompt_len, and requires_raw_input_tokens(model) call all flow into the inherited execution path with no NPU handling

init_asecnd_model_state (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/__init__.py) + patch_model_state.py (vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/) — upstream init_model_state was refactored to resolve_model_state_cls() + supports_prompt_embeds validation; the Ascend override bypasses this validation and still instantiates classes directly, so prompt-embeds rejection/acceptance semantics diverge

AscendModelState (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/default.py) — inherits DefaultModelState which now sets supports_prompt_embeds=True and, when enable_prompt_embeds, allocates PromptEmbedsState (UVA-backed pointer tables) plus a self.inputs_embeds buffer and a non-MM embed_input_ids path; no NPU-specific review of these inherited paths exists
AscendMambaHybridModelState (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/mamba_hybrid.py) — inherits supports_prompt_embeds=True from MambaHybridModelState/DefaultModelState without any prompt-embeds handling

PromptEmbedsState._apply_prompt_embeds_kernel (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/prompt_embeds.py) — new GPU triton kernel using UvaBackedTensor device-pointer indirection (tl.pointer_type over data_ptr), which is incompatible/unverified with triton-ascend and the NPU UVA limitation already patched in patch_uva.py
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit adds opt-in `--enable-prompt-embeds` support to ModelRunner V2 (removes the V2 rejection in vllm/config/vllm.py) and refactors the model_states plumbing. Default (non-prompt-embeds) execution is behavior-preserving, but the feature and the refactor need Ascend adaptation:

1. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/__init__.py — Mirror the refactored upstream init_model_state: split into a class resolver and instance creation, and add the `enable_prompt_embeds` + `cls.supports_prompt_embeds` rejection check (raise the same ValueError for unsupported states). If MRV2 prompt embeds is not validated on NPU yet, explicitly reject `enable_prompt_embeds` in init_asecnd_model_state so users get a clear error instead of an unvalidated GPU path.

2. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/default.py — Decide AscendModelState.supports_prompt_embeds. If supporting it: override prepare_inputs_embeds / add_request / apply_staged_writes / dummy_inputs_embeds to route through NPU-safe embeddings (the inherited non-MM branch calls model.embed_input_ids and PromptEmbedsState.apply with a GPU-tuned triton kernel). If not: set supports_prompt_embeds=False and reject via the init check in (1).

3. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/prompt_embeds.py (new, NPU port) — Provide an NPU implementation of the prompt-embeds overlay. The upstream PromptEmbedsState relies on UvaBackedTensor pointer tables and the triton _apply_prompt_embeds_kernel (tl.pointer_type over raw data_ptr). Reuse/extend patch_uva.py (UvaBufferWrapper) for UvaBackedTensor, and replace the pointer-indirection kernel with a copy/embedding-scatter path or an NPU-verified triton kernel. Note model_runner_v1.py and _310p/model_runner_310p.py already contain an Ascend prompt-embeds implementation (req_prompt_embeds + is_mm_embed splicing) that can be referenced.

4. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py — Verify the inherited add_requests (uses NewRequestData.prompt_len), uses_inputs_embeds, prepare_dummy_inputs, and _execute_model inputs_embeds branch against AscendInputBatch/AscendRequestState (they expose idx_mapping/query_start_loc/num_scheduled_tokens/num_computed_tokens needed by PromptEmbedsState.apply), and update patch_model_state.py/patch_uva.py docs (patch/__init__.py) for the renamed get_mm_embeddings → prepare_inputs_embeds and the refactored init_model_state/resolve_model_state_cls.

5. Also re-check ascend spec-decode and aclgraph paths that call model_state.dummy_inputs_embeds/prepare_inputs_embeds indirectly; the method rename in the ModelState abstract base (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/interface.py) does not break AscendModelState (it never overrode get_mm_embeddings) but any future override must use the new name.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. Default MRV2 behavior on Ascend is unchanged (all new paths are gated behind enable_prompt_embeds), so existing deployments are safe. Risks: (a) if a user enables --enable-prompt-embeds on MRV2 with Ascend, the inherited PromptEmbedsState runs an unvalidated GPU triton pointer-table kernel over UVA-backed tensors that depend on the patched UvaBufferWrapper and pinned_mem_register — likely to crash or produce wrong embeddings on NPU, and no clear rejection is raised because init_asecnd_model_state bypasses the upstream supports_prompt_embeds validation; (b) silently 'supported' prompt embeds for mamba-hybrid/attention-free states that do not actually handle it; (c) V1 prompt-embeds users (already supported in vllm_ascend) migrating to the default V2 runner will hit this path. Adaptation is low-urgency but should land before any MRV2 prompt-embeds enablement on NPU.

commits.message:
[Spec decode] Support Kimi-K3 DCP with DSpark (#52188)

Signed-off-by: wzhao18 <wzhao18.sz@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py::AscendDSparkSpeculator (inherits upstream DSparkSpeculator/DFlashSpeculator input-prep path that calls prepare_dflash_inputs)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit lifts the DSpark+DCP restriction ([SpeculativeConfig] removed the K3DSparkModel DCP ValueError in vllm/config/speculative.py) and adds DCP-aware DSpark/DFlash support upstream. Two concrete adaptations are required in vllm-ascend:

1. HARD BREAK — DFlash/DSpark Triton kernel signature: upstream prepare_dflash_inputs/_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py) now unconditionally pass cp_rank (positional) plus CP_SIZE/CP_INTERLEAVE (constexpr kwargs), and index blocks via ctx_pos // (block_size*CP_SIZE) with a new rank-local slot helper cp_local_slot (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/cp_utils.py). vllm-ascend replaces the kernel with _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py:152), whose signature does NOT include cp_rank/CP_SIZE/CP_INTERLEAVE; every DFlash/DSpark propose step on the v2 model runner will now fail with a Triton launch TypeError (extra args), even when DCP is disabled. Adaptation: extend _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend with cp_rank + CP_SIZE/CP_INTERLEAVE constexpr params and implement the equivalent rank-local slot mapping (identity when CP_SIZE==1 to preserve current NPU behavior), mirroring upstream cp_local_slot and the (block_size*CP_SIZE) block-number computation. Update/extend tests in tests/ut (pattern: upstream tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dflash_prepare_inputs.py new DCP case).

2. Behavioral change in MLA metadata builders: MLACommonMetadataBuilder.__init__ (vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py) now calls self._validate_dspark_dcp_support(supports_dcp_with_varlen), which raises ValueError for DSpark + decode_context_parallel_size>1 unless the builder sets supports_non_causal_multi_token_dcp=True (for non-causal draft) or passes supports_dcp_with_varlen=True (for causal multi-token). All Ascend MLA-family builders (AscendMLAMetadataBuilder, AscendSFAMetadataBuilder, AscendSFAKVOffloadMetadataBuilder, AscendMlaDCPMetadataBuilder, sfa_cp/dsa_cp builders) default supports_dcp_with_varlen=False and do not define the new classvar, so DSpark+DCP on NPU now fails at builder init instead of the (removed) config-time guard. If Ascend intends to support Kimi-K3/Qwen3-DSpark DCP, implement DCP-aware non-causal multi-token decode in the Ascend MLA/SFA impls and set supports_non_causal_multi_token_dcp=True on the builders; otherwise confirm the fail-closed rejection still triggers and document the new error point. Non-DCP DSpark is unaffected by this check.

3. Secondary verifications (additive, low risk): AttentionBackend.validate_configuration gained use_dcp kwarg and supports_non_causal_dcp() (uses builder classvar via getattr, safe); AttentionSelectorConfig gained use_dcp; DraftModelSpeculator._build_draft_attn_metadata gained dcp_local_seq_lens (Ascend build_attn_metadata wrapper already accepts it, vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py:173); dflash/cudagraph.py now calls upstream triton prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/cp_utils.py) during DCP graph capture — vllm-ascend has no NPU replacement for this kernel yet, so verify it runs on NPU or add an Ascend equivalent if DCP+DSpark capture is exercised.
deep_analysis.risk: medium. The DFlash/DSpark kernel signature break is deterministic and affects an actively used NPU feature (AscendDSparkSpeculator/Qwen3DSpark, AscendDFlashSpeculator) — all DFlash/DSpark runs on the v2 model runner fail until the Ascend kernel is updated. If the DCP slot-mapping logic is ported incorrectly (cp_local_slot semantics, interleave handling, block_size*CP_SIZE indexing), draft KV writes land in the wrong rank-local slots, causing silent cache corruption/wrong attention rather than an error. The DSpark+DCP validation move from SpeculativeConfig to MLACommonMetadataBuilder.__init__ changes the failure point for Ascend: unsupported configs now error later (at builder init) and the previously clear config-level message is gone; opting in without real DCP support would mask the failure and produce incorrect results. The remaining changes (validate_configuration use_dcp, supports_non_causal_dcp, dcp_local_seq_lens plumbing) are additive and low-risk.

commits.comment: 引入 JIT kernel warmup 的基础设施（[3/N] 系列）：新增 JitWarmupRegistry 注册表、VllmJitKernel._get_or_compile 运行时编译缓存、Triton 标量特化映射辅助函数 triton_scalar_specialization_rep，并在 kernel_warmup() 中统一编排注册表的 warmup 编译。核心迁移是将 v1 slot-mapping Triton kernel 从裸全局函数重构为 ComputeSlotMappingKernel（VllmJitKernel 子类）单例 _COMPUTE_SLOT_MAPPING_KERNEL，调用方式由 `_compute_slot_mapping_kernel[(grid,)](...)` 变为 `_COMPUTE_SLOT_MAPPING_KERNEL(num_reqs, ...)`，同时删除 v1_block_table_warmup.py。GPUModelRunner（V1/V2）新增 jit_warmup_registry 属性，V2 的 InputBatch 构造/重建被包在 registry.activate() 上下文中以捕获注册；注意 V1 gpu/model_runner.py 的 InputBatch 构造未加 activate()。此外 dispatch 解释器新增 **kwargs 直接转发、下标订阅、in/is 比较、内建函数解析、lambda 支持等能力。潜在风险：旧全局符号 _compute_slot_mapping_kernel 被移除，外部（如 OOT 平台 patch）引用会 ImportError；V1 路径若未正确激活注册表，slot-mapping kernel 可能丢失预热而在首次请求时触发 JIT。

ascend_impact.functionality:
多个文件命中"必然影响/可能影响"路径：
1) vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py 与 vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py：GPUModelRunner 新增 jit_warmup_registry 属性，V2 路径把 InputBatch 构造/重建包在 registry.activate() 中。NPUModelRunnerV2 继承 GPUModelRunner 会自动获得该属性，但 vllm-ascend 通过 patch 将 InputBatch 替换为 AscendInputBatch，只有 AscendInputBatch 构造发生在 activate() 上下文内时，BlockTable 的 warmup 注册才会被收集；若构造发生在上下文外则注册被静默跳过。
2) vllm/v1/worker/block_table.py：模块级全局 Triton kernel `_compute_slot_mapping_kernel` 被删除，替换为 ComputeSlotMappingKernel 实例 `_COMPUTE_SLOT_MAPPING_KERNEL`，Triton kernel 本体改为 `_COMPUTE_SLOT_MAPPING_KERNEL.kernel`。任何直接引用或替换旧符号的 OOT 代码（含 vllm-ascend worker 级 patch）必须改为访问 `_COMPUTE_SLOT_MAPPING_KERNEL.kernel`，否则运行时报 AttributeError/ImportError。
3) vllm/model_executor/warmup/kernel_warmup.py：kernel_warmup() 在 kernel_config.enable_jit_warmup 时调用 worker.model_runner.jit_warmup_registry.warmup()，并删除了对 warm_v1_block_table_kernels 的调用（vllm/model_executor/warmup/v1_block_table_warmup.py 已删除）。Ascend 的 warmup 流程会进入新的注册表编译通道。
4) vllm/v1/worker/cpu_model_runner.py 展示的新模式（替换 `_COMPUTE_SLOT_MAPPING_KERNEL.kernel`）是 OOT 平台替换该 Triton kernel 时必须遵循的新接口。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游新增 tests/v1/worker/test_jit_warmup_migration.py（CUDA-only，验证 ComputeSlotMappingKernel 的 warmup 与 runtime dispatch 一致性）并扩展 tests/model_executor/test_jit_warmup.py（注册表、**kwargs 转发、去重等）。上游测试不覆盖 Ascend 平台，vllm-ascend 需要自行验证新的 warmup 路径与 slot-mapping kernel 在 NPU 上的行为。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend 的 block_table/slot-mapping 相关测试（检查是否引用 _compute_slot_mapping_kernel 旧符号）
Ascend worker compile_or_warm_up_model / kernel_warmup 流程测试（覆盖 jit_warmup_registry.warmup 调用）
AscendInputBatch 构造与 JitWarmupRegistry.activate() 上下文的集成测试

commits.comment: 扩展 DSpark 推测解码的配置识别：当 draft model 的 architectures 包含 DSparkDraftModel 且 hf_config.model_type 为 qwen3 时，自动将 method 判定为 dspark，并将 architectures 改写为 ["Qwen3DSparkModel"] 后执行 update_arch_()。这补全了 DSparkDraftModel 通用包装名与具体 Qwen3DSparkModel 架构之间的桥梁，用户可直接加载通用 DSpark 检查点而无需手动指定 method。变更仅在 SpeculativeConfig 内部，不影响其他推测解码方法，风险低。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/config/speculative.py 命中"可能影响"配置路径。变更扩展了 DSpark 草稿模型自动识别：architectures=DSparkDraftModel + model_type=qwen3 现在会自动设置 method='dspark' 并将架构改写为 Qwen3DSparkModel。vllm-ascend 在 vllm_ascend/spec_decode/ 中提供 DSpark proposer，其激活依赖 SpeculativeConfig.method=='dspark'，该改动扩大了 Ascend 上 DSpark 可用的配置启动方式，Ascend 侧无需修改代码即可受益。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游未新增测试。vllm-ascend 的 DSpark 相关测试可补充 DSparkDraftModel+qwen3 配置的启动用例以覆盖新识别路径，但对现有测试无破坏。
